jobs.occupation: AI Visual Designer – Production & Finishing (all genders) (Mediengestalter/in Digital und Print - Gestaltung und Technik)
jobs.description:
We are looking for YOU – AI Visual Designer – Production & Finishing   – to join Oscar Bravo. Create and perfect AI-generated images for Lufthansa Group brands, select tools, explore creative features, refine details, and ensure every asset meets brand standards and top quality.

What you’ll do:

- Generate AI images and illustrations from briefs using the best tools and workflows
- Refine and finalize assets to be production-ready and brand-compliant
- Correct anatomy, perspective, lighting, materials, and fine details in AI outputs
- Retouch , compose , and optimize images for a natural, consistent brand look
- Implement layouts and adapt formats based on design systems and guidelines
- Apply photography or illustration expertise to composition, lighting, and retouching

- Check typography, colors, file specs, and quality before delivery
- Collaborate with creative teams and maintain organized file structures

Ihr Profil:

- Completed degree or training in Media, Graphic or Communication Design
- Several years’ experience in final artwork, production or prepress, ideally in an agency
- Solid understanding of AI image-generation tools and practical creative application
- Advanced Adobe CC skills (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Acrobat) and strong skills in retouching, photography, illustration and AI asset quality control
- Detail-oriented, quality-driven, visually confident, with a strong eye for typography, layout, color and consistency
- Reliable, structured and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines
- Fluent German and English skills
- Strong collaboration, communication, and interest in new AI technologies
- Portfolio showing precise artwork, high-end retouching and production-ready designs required
- Experience with brand systems and aviation, travel or consumer brands is a plus

We would like to have you join our team for the long term. The position is initially a two-year fixed-term contract, but offers a clear prospect of becoming permanent.

Tanso Technologies GmbH - More about us and the role:Become part of Tanso and decarbonize industries with us.

What if the impact of your role extended beyond a job title?

Not through marketing spin. Not through vague purpose-driven messaging. But through software that helps industrial companies understand, manage and actively reduce their environmental impact.

Thats what Tanso is building. And its one of the reasons people join us.

Why Tanso?

FEV Consulting is the FEV Group's technology-driven top management consultancy. We act as a guide between strategy development and product realization in today's global environment. We do not simply work for companies, but for our customers - people who want to move society forward. That's why we develop and optimize technical product concepts with our focus on customer benefit, feasibility, sustainability and profitability.

We are looking for committed team players. Together with us and our customers, you will actively shape the future of mobility and the energy industry. For our growing team, we are looking for an experienced Sovereign Cloud / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support the secure, reliable, and continuous operation of modern cloud-native and Kubernetes platforms.

You will work with an experienced DevOps/SRE team on highly secure, business-critical platforms, taking responsibility for platform operations, automation, monitoring, incident management, security, and continuous improvement.

The role focuses particularly on Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, logging, and operational excellence within a highly available Unified Observability Platform in a 24x7 operational environment.

Mandatory Requirements – Please Read Before Applying

Citizenship

You must hold valid citizenship in a country that is a full member of both the European Union (EU) and NATO.

If you hold multiple citizenships, all citizenships must be from countries that are members of both the EU and NATO.

Employment in Germany

You must:

- Be employed directly by a legal entity registered in Germany.
- Hold a German employment contract.
- Be subject exclusively to German labor law.
- Comply with all applicable German tax, social-security, and employment regulations.
- Reside in Germany.

Employment through non-German entities, including foreign subcontractors or affiliates, does not meet this requirement.

Security Clearance – Ü2

You must hold a valid and verifiable Ü2 security clearance in accordance with the German Security Clearance Act (Sicherheitsüberprüfungsgesetz – SÜG) and applicable preventive personnel sabotage-protection requirements.

Tasks

Kubernetes & Platform Operations

- Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters with Gardener, including workloads, deployments, Helm charts and platform components.
- Troubleshoot availability, performance and deployment issues.
- Ensure secure, scalable, resilient and highly available platforms.

CI/CD & Automation

- Operate and optimize Jenkins and ArgoCD pipelines for automated deployments.
- Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Git-based deployment workflows.
- Develop automation and operational tools using Python, Go and/or Bash.
- Automate provisioning, health and compliance checks, alerting and reporting.

Monitoring & Observability

- Manage Prometheus, Thanos and OpenTelemetry environments, including scrape jobs, alert rules and PromQL.
- Develop and maintain Grafana dashboards.
- Continuously improve monitoring and alerting capabilities.

Logging & Log Management

- Operate and optimize Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash and Kibana.
- Monitor log ingestion, storage, performance and reliability.
- Support centralized troubleshooting, anomaly detection, security and compliance.

Integration & Operations

- Integrate observability and logging platforms with ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other enterprise tools via secure APIs.
- Handle operational requests.
- Participate in Scrum, DevOps and service-improvement activities.
- Collaborate with internal teams, SAP, suppliers and stakeholders.

Incident & Problem Management

- Participate in a 24/7 on-call and shift rotation, including weekends and public holidays.
- Respond to platform, monitoring, logging and deployment incidents.
- Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
- Support Major Incident Management (MIM).
- Implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Continuously improve platform stability, resilience and operational processes.

Requirements

Key Technologies

Kubernetes | Gardener | Helm | Jenkins | ArgoCD | Git | IaC | Python | Go | Bash | Prometheus | PromQL | Thanos | OpenTelemetry | Grafana | Elasticsearch | OpenSearch | Logstash | Kibana | ServiceNow | PagerDuty | REST APIs

Technical Skills & Experience

- Proven experience as a Sovereign Cloud Engineer and/or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).
- Strong experience operating and maintaining Kubernetes clusters, ideally with Gardener.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes workloads, deployments, Helm charts and platform components.
- Experience troubleshooting availability, performance and deployment issues.
- Experience with Jenkins and ArgoCD for automated CI/CD deployments.
- Solid understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Git-based deployment workflows.
- Programming or scripting experience with Python, Go and/or Bash.
- Experience with automation of provisioning, health checks, compliance checks, alerting and reporting.
- Hands-on experience with Prometheus, PromQL, Thanos and OpenTelemetry.
- Experience developing and maintaining Grafana dashboards and monitoring/alerting solutions.
- Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash and Kibana.
- Understanding of log ingestion, storage, performance and reliability.
- Experience supporting centralized troubleshooting, anomaly detection, security and compliance.
- Experience integrating platforms with ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other enterprise tools via secure REST APIs.
- Experience with incident management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Major Incident Management (MIM).
- Experience working in 24/7 operational environments, including on-call and shift rotations.
- Strong understanding of platform security, scalability, resilience, reliability and high availability.
- Experience working in Scrum and DevOps environments.
- Strong collaboration skills and experience working with internal teams, SAP, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Languages

- English: Required
- German: A plus

Benefits

What You Can Expect

- A technically challenging role within a highly secure and business-critical cloud environment.
- The opportunity to work with modern cloud-native, Kubernetes and observability technologies.
- An international working environment with teams and stakeholders across different locations.
- The opportunity to contribute to automation, platform reliability and continuous improvement.
- Remote / hybrid working possibilities within Germany.

The energy transition is happening now. Help us lead it.

The energy transition is one of the defining challenges of our time. And for commercial and industrial customers, the question is no longer whether to transform — it is how, and how fast.

At Siemens, we are right at the heart of that answer. Through our ONE Tech Company approach, we are aligning our energy management portfolio across businesses to deliver solutions that are smarter, more integrated, and built for what is coming next — not just what exists today.

We are looking for someone who gets excited by that challenge. Someone who can bridge technology and market strategy, connect the dots across a complex organization, and drive real impact — for our customers and for Siemens.

Sounds like you? Read on.

What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- Barrier-free locations

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

Your week will span three perspectives:

- Customer & Market Intelligence- Engage directly with C&I customers to understand challenges and validate portfolio relevance.- Gather market and competitor intelligence to keep Siemens sharp and ahead of the curve.- Monitor AI and emerging technologies and translate relevant trends into actionable recommendations for portfolio and Go-to-Market strategy.- Explore and pilot new business models that go beyond today's existing portfolio.
- Strategy & Portfolio- Shape and align the Go-to-Market strategy for ONE Tech Company Energy Management, including target sales motions and business models.- Drive portfolio transparency across Siemens Energy Management offerings, identify capability gaps, and define actions to meet evolving customer demands.- Leverage technical synergies and guide future portfolio evolution to maximise customer value and business impact.
- Execution & Alignment- Drive joint Go-to-Market initiatives across Smart Infrastructure, Digital Industries and other Siemens businesses.- Navigate and align stakeholders across multiple businesses — building consensus in complexity.- Establish the right operating model for a winning Energy Management go-to-market.

What you should be able to do. So that the world can do more.

- Education- Master's degree in electrical engineering, business administration, digital business management, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- Experience & Skills:- Longterm experience managing a diverse portfolio of hardware, software, and digital services, with a proven track record in developing and selling digital services within a B2B environment.- Understanding of market trends and offerings in commercial and industrial energy solutions, microgrids, and energy efficiency. Demonstrated ability to define and execute successful Go-to-Market strategies.- Awareness of how AI and emerging technologies are reshaping energy management, with the ability to translate these trends into portfolio and Go-to-Market decisions.- Experience applying AI-driven insights to portfolio strategy or Go-to-Market planning is a strong differentiator.- Ability to identify and pursue opportunities beyond existing portfolio boundaries, transforming market insights into actionable initiatives.
- Ways of working- Working backwards from C&I customer needs in Energy Management, challenging the status quo, and leveraging your experience with latest go-to-market approaches and respective commercial models.- Proven experience working across multiple businesses or divisions, building bridges, driving alignment, and thriving in interdisciplinary teams with global colleagues and customers.- Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, bringing structure, driving clarity, and moving forward proactively. You take initiative, contribute your own ideas, and aren't afraid to put them into practice.- Long-term experience within large corporations is a plus.
- Languages: Fluent in English and conversational in German; additional languages are a plus.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
The transition to a sustainable, carbon-neutral future is reshaping the energy, building, and industrial process industries at an unprecedented pace. Renewable energy, storage solutions, and the accelerating electrification of transport and industrial processes are placing new and complex demands on the power grids of tomorrow.
As ONE Tech Company, Siemens is more than the sum of its parts — and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition. We are aligning product and portfolio elements across our businesses, harmonizing our energy management offerings, and building a coherent go-to-market strategy that reflects the full strength of Siemens. High-visibility, cross-functional, and genuinely impactful — this is the role for someone ready to shape the future of energy management from within.
One team. One goal.
In the Chief Technology Office's Digital Portfolio team, we bring together product and portfolio managers, customers, and sales specialists to do one thing exceptionally well: transform our digital products and services so our customers can thrive in the energy transition. Smarter grids. Greener manufacturing. More sustainable buildings and neighborhoods. That is what we are here to build — together.
The technical foundation is there — now we need the right person to bring it all together. We are looking for an experienced professional who can harmonize and lead our go-to-market strategy across existing and new energy management offerings, building a compelling and unified market presence for Siemens. As our "ONE Tech Company Energy Management" Portfolio Manager, you will be the connector — bridging Siemens businesses, fostering collaboration, and driving the technical alignment of our portfolio.

At Siemens, ownership is not a title — it is a mindset. Every employee takes personal responsibility for our success. We empower our leaders to act as owners, make bold decisions, and innovate to win. We communicate with openness and honesty, learn from what does not work, and celebrate what does. We recognize achievements — individual and collective — and we invest seriously in the growth of our people.

To transform the everyday, you need to think outside the box. That’s why we at Siemens are looking for innovators who aren’t afraid to push boundaries to join our diverse team of tech experts. Got what it takes? Then help us create lasting, positive change!

Role overview

Altera is seeking an experienced Field Sales Engineer to drive growth across an assigned territory in the Central EMEA region. Depending on the candidate’s background and the business need, the role may focus primarily on either:

- Growing territory coverage, distribution customers, and channel-partner design wins; or
- Developing a defined set of strategic customers through focused demand creation and account initiatives.

The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, commercial drive, and strong relationship-building skills to turn customer and market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.

Job responsibilities

- Develop and execute sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned revenue and design win targets.
- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities, including early-stage demand creation and design-win activity.
- Manage and grow customer accounts and, where applicable, distribution partners through strong multi-level relationships.
- Own the broader commercial relationship with strategic customers and channel partners, including pricing, contractual terms, volume commitments, supply expectations, and issue escalation.
- Understand customer needs and position Altera’s products and solutions effectively.
- Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, technical proposals, and business cases.
- Drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from prospecting and technical engagement through design win, negotiation, and closure.
- Build joint business plans with channel partners or account plans with strategic customers, depending on the assigned focus.
- Collaborate closely with field application engineering, applications engineering, marketing, product management, and product development.
- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, opportunity plans, and customer information in the CRM system.
- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.
- Represent Altera at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and partner activities.
- Travel regularly within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
- At least five years of successful experience in technical sales, field applications, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, preferably in semiconductors or embedded systems.
- Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets.
- Strong understanding of FPGAs, SoCs, and related hardware and software design flows is highly preferred.
- Experience with distribution partners, channel ecosystems, strategic accounts, or technology-driven customer programs.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong customer-development, opportunity-management, forecasting, and CRM skills.
- Self-motivated, proactive, commercially minded, and results-oriented.
- Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office or comparable tools.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken, is required.

Willingness to travel frequently within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.

Company description

We are looking for a Frontend Lead Developer to shape and improve the frontend applications used across our company. You will define practical frontend standards, guide technical decisions, and turn business and technical requirements into clear, reliable, and easy to use applications.

This role sits at the centre of several digital products, including dashboards, internal applications, PIM and integration solutions, and our Magento based ecommerce shop. You will bring structure to our frontend landscape through a clear architecture, reusable patterns, and modern engineering practices. You will also help us use AI responsibly in the way we design, build, test, and improve frontend applications.

Where your expertise is needed

- Lead the development of scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies
- Establish clear frontend architecture principles, design patterns, coding standards, and reusable components across dashboards, internal applications, ecommerce features, and business tools
- Shape the frontend architecture of our Magento based ecommerce shop and help improve its usability, performance, and maintainability
- Guide the UX team on frontend feasibility, interaction patterns, component reuse, accessibility, and responsive design
- Discuss requirements, priorities, and possible solutions with business stakeholders and turn them into clear technical concepts
- Evaluate frontend technologies and recommend solutions that fit the needs of the business and the wider technical landscape
- Stay involved from the first idea through implementation, testing, release, and continuous improvement
- Apply AI tools and agentic engineering practices to improve frontend development, testing, documentation, and support processes
- Design frontend experiences that work effectively with AI powered features, assistants, agents, and automated workflows

What will help you master future challenges

- Several years of experience building modern web applications, including experience leading frontend projects or guiding frontend teams
- Strong skills in JavaScript or TypeScript and solid experience with React and its surrounding ecosystem
- A practical understanding of reusable components, design systems, frontend testing, accessibility, web performance, and responsive design
- Strong AI proficiency and a clear understanding of how AI can support software development and business applications
- Experience with agentic engineering, including AI assisted development, tool using agents, workflow orchestration, evaluation, and human oversight
- Experience working with APIs, data intensive applications, authentication, and integrations between frontend and backend systems
- The ability to work with teams that have different products, priorities, and technical requirements
- The ability to turn broad business needs into clear frontend strategies, patterns, and working solutions
- A hands on approach - You enjoy setting direction, but you also like to write code and solve problems with the team
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to explain technical decisions to both technical and business stakeholders
- Fluent English at C1 level or above. German is a plus

Your Benefits

- Stable and exciting position within a profitable scale-up company
- Hybrid working model out of one of our offices in Berlin, Düsseldorf or Fulda with remote work from home
- Various benefits, including free fruit and beverages, team and after-work events, as well as digital networking opportunities

- Numerous learning and development opportunities, both within and outside our organization
